items.name: SealQA
items.data: seal_0, seal_hard, longseal; parquet; version can change

items.name: Chinese domain-specific gold dataset
items.source: project-owned proposed dataset; no samples created yet
items.data: planned 60 pilot / eventual 200; no rows selected

items.name: FreshQA
items.data: dated Google Sheets and notebooks, not a pinned downloadable dataset inside repo
items.integration: manually versioned CSV import; question as-of-time evaluation

items.name: FRAMES
items.data: 824 test questions with gold answers and Wikipedia links

items.blocker: web Wikipedia changes; cited links differ from pinned article versions

items.name: DeepSearchQA
items.integration: strict set precision/recall/F1 with judge and human calibration
items.blocker: official grader specifies Gemini 2.5 Flash; long planning/budget

items.name: BrowseComp
items.data: 1266 encrypted test questions in simple-evals; short answers
